subject.title: docs: document replay history normalization contract

question: Should maintainers recreate only the final timeout-parameter comment slice from this PR on current main, ask the contributor to refresh the branch, or leave this stale branch paused?
rationale: The evidence identifies a small useful docs-only remainder, but the protected maintainer label, dirty merge state, and maintainerCanModify=false make this a human refresh/replacement decision rather than a safe automated cleanup close.

options.title: Recreate focused top slice
options.body: Create a current-main docs-only change that adds the two parameter comments to the current helper names and validate with `git diff --check`.

options.title: Ask contributor to refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the contributor to rebase and reduce it to the current-main timeout-comment slice.

options.title: Pause stale branch
options.body: Keep the branch open without action until maintainers decide whether the remaining comments are worth landing.

recommendation.title: Recreate focused top slice
